2835004.text:
[background-block=#0e1114][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/valtron-prosthetics/valtron-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][background=#4FB3FF][color=#0e1114] Work parts [/color][/background][color=#4FB3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#4FB3FF]Who owns us[/color][/url][color=#4FB3FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#4FB3FF]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/valtron-prosthetics/valtron-prosthetics-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/valtron-prosthetics/valtron-prosthetics-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Not everyone can wait for a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white]. When a crane takes your arm on Monday, you need to be back on the docks on Tuesday. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Valtron[/color][/url][color=white] makes the parts for the rest of the country: grey, heavy, honest and cheap. They do not glow and they do not think. They work.[/color]

[color=white]Every Valtron part carries a Valtron ID chip, like every Valtron device, so that it can always be returned to its owner. Wherever it is.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/valtron-prosthetics/valtron-prosthetics-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/valtron-prosthetics/valtron-prosthetics-5.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#4FB3FF][b]WHERE OUR REFURBISHED PARTS COME FROM[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]From customers who upgraded, who moved abroad, or who no longer needed them. Every part is cleaned and tested twice. You will never meet the previous owner.[/color]

[size=130][color=#4FB3FF][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is my arm tracked?[/b][/color][color=white] Every Valtron part has an ID chip. So does every Valtron device. That is what makes it a Valtron.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I take it off at night?[/b][/color][color=white] Of course. Please leave it on the charger, where we can see it.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why does my Basic Eye show ads?[/b][/color][color=white] Because the ads pay for the other half of your eye.[/color]

[color=white][b]Who owns Valtron?[/b][/color][color=white] [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white], since 2077. Nothing has changed, except that now we can see where your arm is.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"A part for every worker. A worker for every part." — Valtron Prosthetics[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/valtron-prosthetics/valtron-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

2835005.text:
[background-block=#140a14][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/second-skin/secondskin-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][background=#FF7AC8][color=#140a14] The looks [/color][/background][color=#FF7AC8] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830621][color=#FF7AC8]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=#FF7AC8] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#FF7AC8]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/second-skin/second-skin-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/second-skin/second-skin-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Your body is the first thing people see. Why let it be the one thing you did not choose? Second Skin makes small implants for big statements: light under the skin, color in the eyes, metal at your fingertips. Nothing heavy. Nothing scary. Just you, upgraded a little.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/second-skin/second-skin-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/second-skin/second-skin-5.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#FF7AC8][b]FOR PARENTS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Every Second Skin look is installed by a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] nurse, with one parent’s signature, from age twelve. Looks connect to the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]KizunaLink[/color][/url][color=white], so you always know how your child is feeling — and so do they. Most of our clients reach 5% Kizuna before they turn sixteen. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Detachment[/color][/url][color=white] starts with something fun.[/color]

[size=130][color=#FF7AC8][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Does it hurt?[/b][/color][color=white] Less than school.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can it be removed?[/b][/color][color=white] Every look can be upgraded.[/color]

[color=white][b]Does Glow Ink work with a [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF][b]Kizuna Core[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]?[/b][/color][color=white] Better than ever. Core carriers glow brighter.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I pay with [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Lockwell[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]?[/b][/color][color=white] Second Skin is a Kizuna company. We do not work with Lockwell. Your parents can.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Flesh is the canvas. We just bring the colors." — Second Skin[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/second-skin/secondskin-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

2835008.text:
[background-block=#0c1220][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][background=#8FC7FF][color=#0c1220] Our dreams [/color][/background][color=#8FC7FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2513519][color=#8FC7FF]The real thing[/color][/url][color=#8FC7FF] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#8FC7FF]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Not every Valian can pay nine credits for a night in Jackpot Eternal. Somnia is the dream for everyone else: simple, short and always the same, sold in every [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]OmniMart[/color][/url][color=white] for one credit. You will not fly. You will not be a hero. You will rest, somewhere a little better than where you are.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-5.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-6.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FC7FF][b]WHAT YOU WILL NOT DREAM[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Somnia dreams are fixed. You cannot choose who is there, you cannot change the ending and you cannot stay longer than the dose. If you want more, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx Experience[/color][/url][color=white] is one aisle over.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FC7FF][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Is Somnia the same as [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]Zyx[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]?[/b][/color][color=white] Somnia is made under license from Zyx, with Zyx compounds, on the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]ZyxNet[/color][/url][color=white]. It is completely different.[/color]

[color=white][b]Why is it so cheap?[/b][/color][color=white] Because there are so many of you.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I get used to it?[/b][/color][color=white] Most of our customers buy the month of nights.[/color]

[color=white][b]Is it free since the [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF][b]Total Connection[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]?[/b][/color][color=white] The basic [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white] of your city is free. Somnia is cheaper than free: it is faster.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Rest is the only luxury everyone can afford. We made it cost one credit." — Somnia[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/somnia/somnia-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]

2835009.text:
[background-block=#120d08][align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/mnemo/mnemo-head.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][b][background=#F0B050][color=#120d08] Keep everything [/color][/background][color=#F0B050] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#F0B050]Who owns us[/color][/url][color=#F0B050] | [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1996515][color=#F0B050]← Back to Los Vales[/color][/url][/b][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/mnemo/mnemo-1.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/mnemo/mnemo-2.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[color=white]Your first word. Your mother’s laugh. The night the Dome showed the sky for four minutes. People forget; Mnemo does not. A small clip behind the ear records what you see and hear, and any day of your life can be lived again, exactly as it was. Not a dream. Not a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832550][color=#7FDBFF]Psychoverse[/color][/url][color=white]. The real thing, kept.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/mnemo/mnemo-4.png[/img][/align]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/mnemo/mnemo-5.png[/img][/align]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#F0B050][b]LEAVE YOUR LIFE TO THE ONES YOU LOVE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]With a Legacy plan, your memories pass to your children with your name. They can sit in a Replay Booth and spend an afternoon inside a day you lived — your wedding, their birth, the last time you were well. It is the only inheritance in Los Vales that does not come with a debt. Almost.[/color]

[size=130][color=#F0B050][b]REMEMBER THE GOOD. FORGET THE REST.[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Mnemo and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832722][color=#7FDBFF]Recall Clinic[/color][/url][color=white] are sister companies. If a memory is too heavy to keep, the Recall Clinic can erase it in two hours. Mnemo will keep a copy, just in case you change your mind.[/color]

[size=130][color=#F0B050][b]FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white][b]Who can see my memories?[/b][/color][color=white] You, your heirs and, when the law requires, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Panoptica[/color][/url][color=white]. The law requires it often.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can I delete a memory?[/b][/color][color=white] Yes. Your copy.[/color]

[color=white][b]What is the difference between Mnemo and [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF][b]Second Chance[/b][/color][/url][color=white][b]?[/b][/color][color=white] Second Chance invents your best day. Mnemo remembers it.[/color]

[color=white][b]Can my employer ask for my memories?[/b][/color][color=white] Only if it is in your contract. It is in your contract.[/color]

[color=#FCFE76][i]"Nothing you live will ever be lost." — Mnemo[/i][/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/mnemo/mnemo-foot.png[/img][/align]

[/background-block]
